autoclose_tooltip: Closes the dialog after this time. Values below 60 are seconds. 0 or empty: stays open
dialog_position_tooltip: Empty: centered. A number is px, e.g. 20 or 10%
help_blind: Shows how far an awning is extended.
help_blind_dialog: An awning that opens a dialog with fixed steps and a slider.
help_cam_mjpg: A camera icon that opens an MJPEG stream; it only runs while the dialog is open.
help_cam_mjpg_oid: Like Cam/Video (img), but the URL of the stream comes from a state.
help_cam_snapshot: A camera icon that opens the snapshot of a camera and loads it again and again.
help_cam_snapshot_oid: Like Cam/Snapshot, but the URL of the snapshot comes from a state.
help_cam_video: A camera icon that opens a video in an HTML5 player.
help_cam_video_object: A camera icon that opens a video for a browser plug-in (QuickTime).
help_cam_video_oid: Like Cam/Video (html5), but the URL of the video comes from a state.
help_custom10: Eleven images of your own, chosen by the value or by the step of the range.
help_custom10_dialog: Custom10 that opens a dialog with fixed steps and a slider.
help_dimmer_dialog: A lamp that opens a dialog with off / 25% / 50% / 75% / 100% and a slider.
help_door: A door contact with three states: closed, tilted or opened.
help_garage: A garage door: closed or opened.
help_heating: The set temperature as radiator icon or as text; opens a dialog with one button per temperature and a slider.
help_light: Shows the brightness of a lamp. The button is pressed while the lamp is on.
help_light_ctrl: Shows the brightness and switches the lamp on and off on click.
help_light_onoff_dialog: A lamp that opens a dialog with the two buttons "off" and "on".
help_roof_window: A roof window contact: closed or opened.
help_shutter: Shows how far a shutter is down.
help_shutter_dialog: A shutter that opens a dialog with closed / 25% / 50% / 75% / open and a slider.
help_socket: Shows whether a socket is on.
help_socket_ctrl: Switches a socket on click - its object, other objects or URLs.
help_valve: Shows the position of a valve.
help_valve_dialog: A valve that opens a dialog with closed / 25% / 50% / 75% / open and a slider.
help_window: A window contact: closed or opened.
help_window_handle: A window with one or two sashes, each with a rotary handle sensor: closed, tilted or opened.
iconValue_tooltip: The icon is shown when the state has exactly this value
icon_interval_tooltip: Loads your own icon again and again, e.g. a snapshot. 0 or empty: never
mui_tooltip: Draws the widget in the colors of the vis-2 theme. Off: the jQuery UI look of vis-1. Widgets from vis-1 have no value here (marked red): they keep the vis-1 look although the box appears ticked - untick and tick it to switch.
oidFalseValue_tooltip: Written to the object for OFF. Empty: Min, or false
oidTrueValue_tooltip: Written to the object for ON. Empty: Max, or true
oid_url_tooltip: The state contains the URL of the picture or of the video
show_active_tooltip: The button is pressed unless the value is at Max
title: Dialog title
